abstract: TerC, a cell line derived from a strain 129 teratocarcinoma 402AX, was used to sensitize syngeneic 129 (H-2bc) splenic lymphocytes in vitro. The effector cells generated inhibited in vitro growth of TerC as measured by an 125I-IUDR ost-labeling technique. It was also shown, with a modified Winn assay, that the sensitized cells were effective in preventing TerC growth in vivo. The effector lymphocyte was nonadherent to nylon wool was sensitive to anti-Thy-1.2 + C, and was phenotypically Ly 1-2+. The anti-TerC effector T lymphocytes were not functional in a 51Cr-release assay. However, this failure to lyse appears not to be due to some intrinsic membrane resistance since both BCG and ConA-activated killers were able to lyse TerC. The TerC-sensitized lymphocytes displayed no H-2 restriction and were able to growth inhibit in vitro a wide range of tumorigenic cell lines, e.g., P815 (H-2d), EL-4 (H-2b),Sal (H-2a), and BALB/c (H-2d) 3T12. Mouse blastocyst cell lines were also inhibited. BALB/c 3T3 and mouse fibroblast cell strains were not growth inhibited. Thus, it appears that oncofetal antigens expressed on TerC are capable of initiating a cell-mediated response and that these antigenic specificities are shared by many transformed cell lines.
abstract_ja: 129系マウス由来の奇形癌402AXの細胞株TerCを用いて、同系129系(H-2bc)の脾リンパ球を体外で感作した。生成された効果細胞は、125I-IUdR後標識法によりin vitroでのTerCの増殖を抑制した。改変Winnアッセイにより、感作細胞はin vivoでもTerCの増殖を防止できることが示された。効果リンパ球はナイロンウール非付着性で、抗Thy-1.2+補体に感受性であり、表現型はLy 1-2+であった。抗TerC効果T細胞は51Cr遊離法では機能せず溶解できなかった。ただし、この溶解不全は膜の内在性抵抗によるものではないと思われる。BCGおよびConA活性化キラー細胞はTerCを溶解可能だった。TerC感作リンパ球はH-2拘束性を示さず、多様な腫瘍性細胞株の増殖をin vitroで抑制した。マウス胚盤胞細胞株も抑制された。BALB/c 3T3およびマウス線維芽細胞株は増殖抑制されなかった。したがって、TerCに発現するオンコフェタル抗原が細胞性免疫応答を惹起でき、これら抗原特異性は多くの形質転換細胞株に共通していると思われる。
